p.espaces.rg_d: Customs, product standards, starting a business, investment platforms: official sources of each country.
p.espaces.rg_sub: The rules change often: ONE WORLD does not copy them, it opens the latest official sources, then you read them in your language.
p.espaces.rg_g1: Global Trade Aid (ITC, UNCTAD, WTO): product and country, duties, taxes, rules and procedures all on one page
p.espaces.rg_g2: Market Access Card (MAC): customs duties and rules of origin
p.espaces.rg_g3: ePing (WTO): standards, labelling and health regulations applied to products in this country
p.espaces.rg_e1: Access2Markets: trade to and from the EU, step by step
p.espaces.rg_e2: Taric: Customs Code and taxes on goods entering the EU
p.espaces.rg_b1: Business Ready (World Bank): Starting a business, taxes, international trade, country by country
p.espaces.rg_i1: I-SCAN (IOSCO): check if the regulator has marked the platform before you entrust your money to it
p.espaces.rg_note: The site opens in your language: use the browser's translation function, or « Understand the document » to find the document.For important decisions, ask a professional in your country.
p.espaces.cu_d: Duties, documents, Incoterms, free official tools, forwarders and carriers.
p.espaces.cu_sub: 24/24 ONE WORLD does not file customs declarations: a licensed customs broker (freight forwarder) can do this for you, but it is possible if you have a license.
p.espaces.cu_t1: Market Access Map (ITC, UN-WTO): Duties and Regulations for almost all countries
p.espaces.cu_t2: Access2Markets (European Union): duties, taxes, rules of origin, step by step
p.espaces.cu_t3: TARIC: Customs code (HS code) and duties on the entry of goods into the EU
p.espaces.cu_t4: French customs: EORI, customs formalities, simulators
p.espaces.cu_d3: Transport document: Waybill (sea), Air Waybill (air), CMR (road)
p.espaces.cu_d4: Certificate of origin (to receive reduced taxes)
p.espaces.cu_d5: EORI number (for companies importing or exporting in the EU)
p.espaces.cu_d6: Depending on the product: health or phytosanitary certificate, license, CE standards
p.espaces.cu_i1: EXW: Buyer handles everything from seller's factory.
p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: The seller delivers the goods to the buyer’s carrier, who clears the export customs formalities.
p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: The seller loads the goods on board the ship; then risk and cost pass to the buyer.
p.espaces.cu_i4: CIF: The seller pays the freight and insurance costs until the port of arrival.
p.espaces.cu_i5: DAP: The seller delivers the goods at destination, the buyer pays import duties.
p.espaces.cu_i6: DDP: The seller pays everything, including import duties.
p.espaces.cu_ban: Forbidden or controlled everywhere: weapons, drugs, counterfeits, protected species (CITES), some medicines. Such lists are rejected and can be reported.
p.espaces.cu_src: Sources: ICC (Incoterms 2020), ITC, European Commission, Always check the exact terms for your product.

p.espaces.mt_d: Western Union, MoneyGram, Wise, Remitly... compare the charges in your country before shipping.
p.espaces.mt_sub: 24/24 ONE WORLD itself does not send money and does not earn anything from these links: you compare here, then send with the chosen service.
p.espaces.mt_wb: Money transfer prices worldwide (World Bank): real cost of sending money, by country, service by service
p.espaces.mt_p_wu: Cash withdrawal in many countries, bank transfer, mobile wallet
p.espaces.mt_p_mg: Cash withdrawal, bank transfer, mobile wallet
p.espaces.mt_p_wise: Bank transfer at market exchange rate, fees are shown before shipment
p.espaces.mt_p_rem: Bank transfer, mobile wallet, cash withdrawal
p.espaces.mt_p_wr: Mobile wallet, bank transfer, cash withdrawal
p.espaces.mt_p_tt: Send to mobile wallet or bank account
p.espaces.mt_k1: Look at the total amount received: commission + exchange rate, the worse than the market rate is the hidden payout.
p.espaces.mt_k2: Choose how the person receives it: cash, bank account or mobile wallet (M-Pesa, Orange Money, MTN...).
p.espaces.mt_k3: Often, an identity document is required for both sending and receiving.
p.espaces.mt_k4: Never send money to someone you only met online, or to "unlock" a prize, package, loan or visa: it's almost always a scam.
p.espaces.mt_note: Services and prices change: always check their website when you ship.
p.espaces.ds_d: Sell without stock: find a supplier, develop a real price, stay within the law.
p.espaces.ds_sub: Dropshipping means selling products that are shipped directly from the supplier to your customer. Easy to start, but you remain responsible for the sales.
p.espaces.ds_s1: Choose a product that is authorised in your customers’ country: no counterfeits, no unauthorised regulated products.
p.espaces.ds_s2: Find a supplier (wholesale/supplier listings here or wholesale platforms) and order a sample before selling.
p.espaces.ds_s3: Calculate the real price: product, delivery, customs duties, VAT in the customer's country, payment fee and return.
p.espaces.ds_s4: Tell your customers the actual delivery time.
p.espaces.ds_s5: Register your business: company status, VAT and taxes according to your country (see Trade conditions).
p.espaces.ds_s6: Respect consumer rights: clear prices including taxes, right of return, guarantee, data protection.
p.espaces.ds_w1: A supplier who wants to receive full payment by unsecured bank transfer or in cryptocurrency.
p.espaces.ds_w2: Paid courses that promise to make you rich fast.
p.espaces.ds_w3: Stolen photos and fake reviews: prohibited and punishable.
p.espaces.ds_w4: In the European Union, VAT is payable on the first euro of a parcel from a non-EU country.
